aria: Animated recap of the Rockets' 125 to 118 home win over the Jazz: Fred VanVleet's bank shot as the shot clock ran out with 11 seconds left that made it 123 to 118, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Alperen Şengün's 43 points on 17-of-24 shooting, the top scorers, how the Rockets won, and the next game at Washington.
notes: Final score and quarter scores (27–27 after one, 63–53 Houston at the half, 92–89 after three, 125–118 final) from the Associated Press (via the Deseret News, ABC News and KUTV) and Field Level Media; the quarter scores add up to both totals. Player lines were first taken from written recaps and then checked against the full box score (SportRadar feed) at 8:30 AM ET: Şengün's 43 points, 12 rebounds, 5 assists and 17-of-24 shooting (AP; Yahoo Sports), Kevin Durant's 22 points, 6 assists and 10-of-10 free throws (AP; Fadeaway World via Yahoo Sports), Fred VanVleet's 17 and 3-of-6 from three (the 3-of-3 in early recaps was wrong), Tari Eason's 14 and 11 rebounds, Amen Thompson's 12 and 10 rebounds (Fadeaway World; Field Level Media). Those lines account for 108 of Houston's 125 points, plus 11 from Bogdanovic (Fadeaway World); the box score has the other 6 (Jabari Smith Jr.); Eason's 14 points and 11 rebounds are from the written recaps (he is missing from the feed's player list, and its other lines leave exactly 14 points). Team stats (rebounds 47–41, points in the paint 52–46, blocks 8–4, turnovers 8–13, threes 35.3% to 36.6%) are from Fadeaway World. Utah's 10-point lead (87–77 with 3:31 left in the third) is from Field Level Media; Houston's biggest lead was 12 (box score). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Utah's 3-point shooting drove a 9–0 run that tied it at 69 and an 11–0 run capped by Ace Bailey's three-point play; Bailey's 3-pointer made it 87–77 with 3:31 left in the third. Şengün and VanVleet then led a 15–2 run to close the quarter, Şengün scoring on a second-chance basket, a driving layup and a free throw in succession (Field Level Media). It was Şengün's season high and the second 40-point game of his career (AP). Darryn Peterson scored a career-high 28 and Keyonte George 27 for Utah, which has lost 11 straight (AP; Field Level Media). Jaxson Hayes left with a left knee injury and did not return (Field Level Media). Houston has won three straight (AP) and plays at Washington on Sunday, Nov 15.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Fred VanVleet's bank shot as the shot clock expired with 11 seconds left, which extended the lead to 123–118 (Field Level Media; Fadeaway World: "a clutch bucket as the shot clock expired to put the Rockets up five"). The sources don't give the distance, whether it was a two or a three, or the score just before it, so the board shows only that Houston led, and the shot is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from mid-range. Durant's two free throws then made it 125–118 (Fadeaway World). The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Houston Rockets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to VanVleet’s listed 6-foot-0 and 197 pounds (RealGM), in Houston's home white with No. 5 (RealGM). No wingspan from a reliable measurement is reported, so his arms are drawn at a 1.0 ratio. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
